_status: Traditional rates VERIFIED against the official LTFRB PUJ General Fare Guide (effective 2026-09-28, first source below). Modern rates are from news reports only; confirm against the LTFRB modern PUJ fare guide before launch
authority: LTFRB, approved by DOTr (memorandum dated 2026-09-25, lifting the March 2026 suspension)
discountNotes: Students get the discount every day, including Saturdays, Sundays and holidays, per LTFRB MC 2017-024 (stated on the LTFRB PUJ General Fare Guide).
rounding: Fares are rounded off to the nearest 25 centavos, per the LTFRB PUJ General Fare Guide (e.g. 5 km discounted: 12.80 is shown as 12.75).
